instruction: Modify the system PATH environment variable globally to include /opt/custom/bin for all users on Ubuntu.

metadata.explanation: This task involves modifying global environment variables in /etc/environment or /etc/profile, which affects system-wide configuration. Verification would require checking environment variables across different shell sessions and user contexts, which is not reliably evaluable in the current framework.
